data_card.measured: Flow depths at the inlets and discharges at the outlets for a junction, a bifurcation and a district model, plus 2D surface velocities for eight urban-form layouts of the district model.
data_card.method: Laboratory measurements at the University of Liège, as described in the data descriptor; surface velocities by image velocimetry.
data_card.uncertainty: To be taken from the data descriptor.
known_issues: The repository licence is still to be confirmed.
data_card.exercises: Flow partition between streets at crossroads and the effect of urban form on depths and outlet discharges.
data_card.cannot_tell: A steady laboratory flow at small scale: it does not test the unsteady arrival of a flood, and scale effects (surface tension, laminar regions) are possible in shallow streets.

title: Laboratory urban district, University of Liège
